title: SWF + model + UI: Gradient Glow, Gradient Bevel, and Adjust Color (ColorMatrix) filters
description:
Flash 8 exposes 7 filters; only 4 are implemented (drop-shadow, blur, glow, bevel). Missing three:
- Gradient Glow (SWF filter ID 4)
- Gradient Bevel (SWF filter ID 7)
- Adjust Color / ColorMatrix (SWF filter ID 6)

Gaps:
1. packages/core/src/engine/filters.ts — union type has no GradientGlowFilter, GradientBevelFilter, AdjustColorFilter variants
2. packages/swf/src/filters.ts — encoder has no branches for IDs 4, 6, 7
3. packages/authoring-ui/src/FiltersPanel.tsx — UI only offers 4 filter types
4. packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts — CanvasRenderer has no CSS-filter path for these types

Acceptance:
- All three filter types can be added and edited in the Filters panel.
- A document with each filter type compiles to a SWF with the correct FILTERLIST record (verify filter ID byte with parse-back).
- CanvasRenderer renders a reasonable approximation (exact parity with Ruffle is ideal; approximation is acceptable for the authoring preview).
- Add tests to packages/swf/src/__tests__/filters.test.ts for each new filter type.
